name: Badamasi Azeezat Damilola
bio: I am a final-year medical student with a strong interest in obstetrics and gynecology. I am passionate about improving maternal and child health and aspire to make a lasting impact in this field. Through my clinical experiences, I've developed a deep appreciation for compassionate, evidence based care. Outside of medicine, I enjoy going on walks, listening to music, and exploring new restaurants.
